meta.note: Friday briefing. Three headlines: Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCC lead time stretches to 52 weeks and Yageo plans a new hike round for late Oct-Nov (high-cap possibly +50%+); Kingboard's 8th hike letter of the year (+15%), general PCB lead times 2 weeks to 6-8 weeks, copper foil and glass cloth move to quota allocation; systematic industrial-component repricing continues (sensors up to +50%, relays +25%, connectors +30%, UBS report on analog chip prices/inventory). Carrier to invest over $600M in a Fort Worth advanced manufacturing & engineering center; Hitachi spins off home appliances as KADENOVA; Lenovo launches 6th-gen Poseidon liquid cooling (PUE 1.04); Goaland Q3 net profit +207.89%; Gree wins 'internationally leading' ratings for three in-house technologies; Samsung's Southeast Asia / Oceania smart HVAC strategy. Yangshan copper premium at $158/t, highest since Feb 2014; Panasonic US October hike 3.7%-4.0% (effective Oct 19); ZSI-Foster/Wesanco hike effective Oct 26, 3 days out. Event store: 3 new events (Carrier Fort Worth / Hitachi KADENOVA / Lenovo Poseidon Gen 6), 6 timeline entries appended (MLCC/DRAM/PCB-CCL/copper/North America hikes/transformers), 41 events in total.

hotspot_events.title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCC lead time stretches to 52 weeks; Yageo plans a new hike round for late Oct-Nov
hotspot_events.heat_reason: Lead time out to a full year + makers hiking proactively to suppress low/mid-cap orders + TrendForce sees further Q4 increases - multiple lines converging, a clear action window

sources.outlet: 21st Century Business Herald (via CLS / Korea Herald Business)

hotspot_events.summary: Samsung Electro-Mechanics' MLCC order lead time has stretched to 52 weeks; it plans to raise consumer-grade X5R prices by an average 25%-30% in 2026 Q4 to curb low/mid-cap orders and free lines for high-end parts; its component division ran at 91% utilization in H1, and the new Philippines line will not ramp until after 2027. Yageo plans a new hike round for late Oct-Nov (high-cap possibly +50%+, low/mid-cap +10%-30%, running through 2027 Q1); TrendForce expects Q4 consumer mid/high-cap quotes to rise a further 10%-20%.
numbers: TrendForce: Q4 consumer mid/high-cap quotes +10%-20% further

hotspot_events.title: CCL prices rise again in October; PCB lead times stretch across the board
hotspot_events.heat_reason: Kingboard's 8th hike letter of the year + lead times 2 weeks to 6-8 weeks + copper foil and glass cloth on quota allocation - multiple lines converging, a clear action window
hotspot_events.summary: Kingboard Laminates issued its 8th hike letter of the year on Oct 13 (thin-fabric boards of 2116 and below / PP new orders +15%); Shengyi raised board/PP prices another 10-20% in early October; Panasonic has notified +200% on conventional multilayer CCL for shipments from Jan 1, 2027 (channel report). General FR-4 lead times have stretched from ~2 weeks to 6-8 weeks, high-layer/impedance boards 12-24 weeks; copper foil and low-Dk glass cloth have moved to quota allocation, prioritizing long-contract key accounts; 7628 e-glass fabric is up to RMB 13.5-14/m (up over 200% since Sep 2025).
numbers: Kingboard: 8th hike letter of the year, +15%
General FR-4 lead time: 2 weeks to 6-8 weeks

hotspot_events.title: Systematic repricing of industrial components continues
hotspot_events.heat_reason: Sensors/relays/connectors repricing across the board + UBS analog price-and-inventory double signal - the hike chain is stacking on multiple lines
hotspot_events.summary: Since 2026 Q1, sensor makers ST / Allegro / Novosense / SmartSens have raised prices 10%-50%; Omron/Schneider relays followed with +10%-25%; Turck/Pepperl+Fuchs sensors +15%-35%; Phoenix Contact/Weidmueller connectors +12%-30%. UBS's Oct 16 report: analog distribution inventory -7% to -10% QoQ, True Analog average prices +12% QoQ, Power Analog +9%, the share of parts on extended lead times up from 62% to 65%, and MCU lead times as long as ~52 weeks.
numbers: MCU lead times up to ~52 weeks
